cast.title: Wildcat
cast.overview: Can scandalous art still serve God? Does suffering precede all greatness? Can illness be a blessing? In 1950, writer Flannery O'Connor visits her mother Regina in Georgia when she is diagnosed with lupus at twenty-four years old. Struggling with the same disease that took her father’s life when she was a child and desperate to make her mark as a great writer, this crisis pitches her imagination into a feverish exploration of belief.

cast.title: Revolver
cast.overview: Takes place on June 27, 1966, when The Beatles’ flight to Japan is forced to make an unexpected stop in Anchorage, AK. The band takes cover in a hotel, where Jane devises a plan to realize the ultimate teenage dream: to lose her virginity to George Harrison.

cast.title: Asteroid City
cast.overview: In an American desert town circa 1955, the itinerary of a Junior Stargazer/Space Cadet convention is spectacularly disrupted by world-changing events.

cast.title: Honey I Sure Miss You
cast.overview: A tribute to the late Daniel Johnston featuring covers from 15 different artists, released for the one year anniversary of the death of Daniel Johnston.

cast.title: Maestro
cast.overview: A towering and fearless love story chronicling the lifelong relationship between Leonard Bernstein and Felicia Montealegre Cohn Bernstein. A love letter to life and art, Maestro at its core is an emotionally epic portrayal of family and love.

cast.title: Bay of Cadiz
cast.overview: Bay of Cadiz follows Maya Hawke and renowned sushi chef Shigeru Mikami on a train ride. Sat on either side of a table, the pair converse without exchanging a single word. Instead, a voiceover narrates the uncanny events that take place on the train.

cast.title: The Kill Room
cast.overview: A hitman, his boss, an art dealer and a money-laundering scheme that accidentally turns the assassin into an overnight avant-garde sensation, one that forces her to play the art world against the underworld.

cast.title: Inside Out 2
cast.overview: Teenager Riley's mind headquarters is undergoing a sudden demolition to make room for something entirely unexpected: new Emotions! Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust, who’ve long been running a successful operation by all accounts, aren’t sure how to feel when Anxiety shows up. And it looks like she’s not alone.

cast.title: Wilder & Me
cast.overview: Part coming-of-age story, part true-life portrait of the beloved Billy Wilder, the film is set during the summer of 1977, when an innocent young woman begins working for the famed director and his screenwriter Iz Diamond on a Greek island during the filming of Fedora.

cast.title: Ladyworld
cast.overview: After a catastrophic event, eight girls find themselves stranded in a house without electricity. As they run out of food and water, their sanity begins to crumble, and soon they regress to their baser instincts.

cast.title: Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood
cast.original_title: Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood
cast.overview: Los Angeles, 1969. TV star Rick Dalton, a struggling actor specializing in westerns, and stuntman Cliff Booth, his best friend, try to survive in a constantly changing movie industry. Dalton is the neighbor of the young and promising actress and model Sharon Tate, who has just married the prestigious Polish director Roman Polanski…

cast.title: Mainstream
cast.overview: A young woman thinks she’s found a path to internet stardom when she starts making YouTube videos with a charismatic stranger  – until the dark side of viral celebrity threatens to ruin them both.

cast.title: Human Capital
cast.overview: Ian begins a relationship with Drew's daughter, who works in the financial sector. The couple gets involved in a tragic accident that will change their lives forever. At the same time, the accident has a major impact on both their families who, despite the class difference, cross paths.

cast.title: As They Slept
cast.overview: Eleanor and Margaret are childhood friends. After one semester spent apart at universities, they get together for an evening in the city, testing their friendship.

cast.title: Memory Xperiment: Kathy Acker
cast.overview: A short film based on the literary work of author Kathy Acker. Set in the 60's and 70's, a young female writer explores her identity through sex and writing.

cast.title: Do Revenge
cast.overview: A dethroned queen bee at a posh private high school strikes a secret deal with an unassuming new student to enact revenge on one another’s enemies.

cast.title: Italian Studies
cast.overview: A mysterious woman wanders the streets of Manhattan in a confused state. Finding herself inexplicably drawn to a group of teenagers she embarks on an adventure with them through the cityscape and into the unknown. As the night progresses, she approaches something intangible on the journey back to herself.

cast.title: Fear Street: 1994
cast.overview: After a series of brutal slayings, a teen and her friends take on an evil force that's plagued their notorious town for centuries.

cast.title: Videoheaven
cast.overview: Since the 1980s, the video shop has been a desperately necessary space for film culture. In Videoheaven, Alex Ross Perry tells the story of the neighbourhood video shop to consider wider, changing social histories, using appropriated footage from the high and lowbrow.

cast.title: The Non-Actor
cast.overview: Elliot is staying with her ex’s new girlfriend while attending a medical trial for her recent, unexplained loss of hearing. As she reconfigures her relationship with her (sonic) environment and herself, an intimate connection sparks between the two women.

cast.title: Lucia
cast.overview: Based on the life of Lucia Joyce, the talented but troubled daughter of James Joyce. The film follows Lucia as she struggles to fulfil her personal ambition to become a professional dancer, while navigating her complex relationship with her father as his muse and confidant.

cast.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
cast.original_title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
cast.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

cast.title: Wishful Thinking
cast.overview: Julia, an ambitious game designer, and Charlie, a struggling musician, are at a loss for how to repair their volatile relationship. After attending a couples-therapy seminar run by mysterious twin healers, they find that the ups-and-downs of their relationship have supernatural effects on the world around them. With earthquakes, the stock market, and entire nations at risk, Charlie and Julia must confront whether their passionate love can survive amidst so much chaos.

cast.title: One Night Only
cast.overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

cast.title: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
cast.original_title: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
cast.overview: An inside look at the years of effort and craft that went into the final installment of the Duffer Brothers' generation-defining series.

cast.title: Symbiosis
cast.overview: On the ruins of the Anthropocene, humanity has made way for a rich biotope teeming with mixed life-forms: human, animal, and machine hybrids. There is no competition, only symbiosis.

cast.title: Maya Hawke - live on KEXP
cast.overview: KEXP presents Maya Hawke performing live in the KEXP studio

cast.title: Faith
cast.overview: In 1990s Los Angeles, a young man caught between survival, crime, and identity finds himself behind bars. There, he discovers Islam and a new sense of purpose—but his past refuses to let him go.

cast.title: Each Day in a Moment
cast.overview: A period of life is shown through flickers of moments.

cast.title: Inside Out 3
cast.overview: The third Installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

cast.title: Magic: The Gathering
cast.overview: A live-action adaptation. Plot TBA.

crew.title: Lost Angel: The Genius of Judee Sill
crew.original_title: Lost Angel: The Genius of Judee Sill
crew.overview: The never-before-told story of folk-rock icon Judee Sill, who in just two years went from living in a car to appearing on the cover of Rolling Stone. The documentary charts her troubled adolescence through her meteoric rise in the music world and early tragic death. Featuring Linda Ronstadt, Jackson Browne, David Crosby, Graham Nash, Fleet Foxes, David Geffen, and more.

crew.title: Reconstructing Utøya
crew.overview: This documentary picks up after the horror has ended. Almost 500 teens are in grief as 69 of their friends have fallen. They've been shot dead. How could this island ever become a safe place again? Here, we see how Utøya was first the safest place on Earth to the most terrible and how it was restored and stands as a beacon of hope for the survivors and the Norwegian people.

crew.title: The Funeral
crew.overview: A girl gives a eulogy for her father's funeral.
